scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build-client -- --minify && npm run build-server -- --minify && cp ../language-server/src/https-loader.js out/https-loader.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build-client -- --sourcemap && npm run build-server -- --sourcemap && cp ../language-server/src/https-loader.js out/https-loader.mjs
scripts.build-server: esbuild ../language-server/src/server.js --bundle --external:fsevents --external:@hyperjump/browser --external:@hyperjump/json-schema --external:@hyperjump/json-schema/* --main-fields=module,main --outfile=out/server.mjs --format=esm --platform=node --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"

configuration.title: Configuration for JSON Schema Language Server

jsonSchemaLanguageServer.defaultDialect.description: The default JSON Schema dialect to use if none is specified in the schema document

jsonSchemaLanguageServer.schemaFilePatte.description: The glob pattern for identifying JSON Schema files.

jsonSchemaLanguageServer.customVocabular.description: A list of npm package identifiers (e.g. 'my-vocab@1.0.0') to load as custom vocabularies via esm.sh
